userStories.title: Retired/renamed registry metadata + update migration notes (#279, PRD D-15)
userStories.description: Add retired/renamed metadata to src/modules/registry.ts: for each retired or renamed spell/component, its successor (if any) and a one-line reason. Real history (verified): spell-bootstrap-business -> spell-summon-venture (CHANGELOG BREAKING rename), spell-assess -> spell-scope (ARC-007/008), retired static `agent-files` component (see the registry's own 'the static `agent-files` component was retired' comment and ARC-047). `spell update` prints one 'Registry changes since your install' section: for each tracked-but-retired item, its successor and reason. It deletes nothing without --prune (orphan handling unchanged).
acceptanceCriteria: upgrading a fixture manifest that tracked spell-bootstrap-business prints successor spell-summon-venture and the reason
nothing deleted without --prune; existing orphan tests pass
userStories.testEvidence: test/up03-a-registry-changes.test.ts 9/9 (legacy spell-prompts manifest tracking spell-bootstrap-business prints successor spell-summon-venture + reason; agent-files note; file kept without --prune, pruned only with --prune via existing orphan path); test/update.test.ts + test/registry.test.ts 314/314 unchanged

userStories.title: `.gitattributes` for every profile (#281, PRD D-09)
userStories.description: Split `.gitattributes` out of `docs-baseline` into its own component (initOnly, skipExisting, same asset source) included in EVERY profile; docs-baseline keeps `.gitignore`. Keep legacy manifests working: a manifest listing docs-baseline with .gitattributes tracked must not orphan or re-copy it (check migrateLegacyComponents/orphan sweep behaviour and add a migration if needed). Existing installs learn about the new component via story 2's report, never auto-install. Run `npm run fix:spell-catalog` if catalog artifacts change.
acceptanceCriteria: `spell init --dry-run` for full, lite, methodology, docs, governance-only each lists .gitattributes
an existing docs-baseline install upgrading does not lose, orphan or duplicate .gitattributes
userStories.testEvidence: test/up03-a-gitattributes.test.ts 13/13 (built CLI `spell init --profile X --dry-run` lists .gitattributes for full/lite/methodology/docs/governance-only; pre-split docs-baseline manifest upgrade keeps .gitattributes byte-identical, no orphan, recorded once under line-ending-baseline; same-version still 'Already up to date.' with manifest untouched; old lite install offered `spell add line-ending-baseline`, never given it); check:spell-catalog passes; 38 related files 765/765
